changelog:
================================================================================
AKD YT (PC AIM STUDIO) - v2.1.0 AKD PC ESPORTS RELEASE
================================================================================

[1] FREE FIRE DIRECT KEYMAPPING & SCHEMES ENGINE
  - Full dynamic enumeration of all keymapping schemes (AUTO HEAD, Smart, Standard, Custom).
  - Exact Tweaks loading (807488066 / 16450 / 21058 / 808016450).
  - Accurate Mouse Sensitivity X (4.73) & Mouse Sensitivity Y (2.63) calculation.
  - Low-latency ExclusiveDelay tuning (200ms -> 2-50ms).
  - Pan center coordinates (X: 79.85%, Y: 44.75%) & Disable Mouse Acceleration toggle.
  - Corruption-proof JSON serialization with automatic timestamped .bak backups.

[2] DEDICATED HARDWARE MOUSE & EASE OF ACCESS SPEED CONTROLLER
  - Embedded directly inside the "FF Config" page under the "MOUSE SETTINGS" tab.
  - Real-time PC hardware readouts with live bidirectional synchronization.
  - Pointer Speed slider (1 to 20, Default 10) via Win32 SPI_SETMOUSESPEED.
  - Double-Click Speed slider (100ms to 900ms, Default 500ms) via SetDoubleClickTime.
  - Ease of Access Mouse Keys Top Speed slider (10 to 360) via registry & SPI_SETMOUSEKEYS.
  - Ease of Access Mouse Keys Acceleration slider (1000ms to 5000ms) via registry & SPI_SETMOUSEKEYS.
  - 1-Click "Apply Real-Time Mouse Settings" & "Restore Original Mouse Backup".

[3] BLUESTACKS & MSI INSTANCE MAX FPS (.CONF) ENGINE
  - Multi-instance scan for bluestacks.conf across Pie64, Nougat32, Nougat64, and Rvc64.
  - 1-Click unlock presets: 60, 90, 120, 144, 240, 360, 999 FPS.
  - Enforces enable_high_fps="1" and max_fps across all instances simultaneously.

[4] HIGH-PRECISION IN-GAME HUD WINDOW METER
  - 8 Dynamic physical HUD shapes (Cyber Pill, Hexagon, Terminal, Blade, Royal Gold).
  - Hardware-accelerated window region clipping (SetWindowRgn) with zero top/bottom clipping.
  - Full DPI scaling support with responsive text rendering.

[5] PURE CLOUD GIST LICENSING & DEVELOPER REMOTE KILL-SWITCH
  - Pure cloud Gist authorization: authorized users are granted full VIP access from the cloud.
  - Continuous wall-clock countdown timer with auto-updating expiration status.
  - Dual-tier Discord telemetry logging (Master Guard + Client Notifications).
  - Remote kill-switch protection: blacklisted or revoked SIDs terminate immediately (ExitProcess 0xDEAD).

[6] UI ALIGNMENT & TITLE OVERLAP FIX
  - Cleaned title bar layout: eliminated badge overlap on buttons.
  - Unified single status badge for license state and remaining subscription time.
================================================================================
